NEW YORK, Sept. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Conference Board Consumer Confidence Index® fell by 6.7 points to 81.9 (1985=100) in September, down from 88.6 in August. The Present Situation Index—based on consumers' assessment of current business and labor market conditions—retreated by 7.9 points to 109.3. The Expectations Index—based on consumers' short-term outlook for income, business, and labor market conditions—fell by 5.9 points to 63.6, its third consecutive monthly decline.
